content.text: My name is Catherine and today we have an advanced level lesson for you guys all about food.

content.text: What kind of food are we talking about today Marco?

content.text: Today we're talking about cheese. So there's so many different types of cheese, so many varieties.
content.trans: 今天我们谈论奶酪。所以有很多不同的类型，很多种类。

content.text: So we're going to take a look at these varieties. You may know them or not.
content.trans: 英语：所以我们将来看看这些品种。你可能知道它们或不知道。

content.text: But we're also going to take a look at the pronunciation because most of them are either Italian or French.
content.trans: 但是我们还打算看看发音，因为大多数都是意大利语或法语。

content.text: So how do you pronounce these in maybe in American English?

content.text: Good question. Let's listen to our dialogue for the first time and we'll be back in a moment to talk about the wonderful world of cheese.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。让我们先听听我们的对话，然后在稍后讨论美味的奶酪世界吧。

content.text: Hello everyone. My name is Laurie and I want to welcome you to this course.
content.trans: 你好，大家。我的名字是露西，我想要欢迎你们参加这个课程。

content.text: We will learn all about one of the oldest yet most delicious foods on this planet.
content.trans: 我们将在这个星球上学习一下地球上最美味的一道老菜。

content.text: Cheese. Let's get started.
content.trans: 英语：奶酪。让我们开始。

content.text: Cheese is usually categorized into four types.
content.trans: 牛奶、黄油和奶酪通常被归类为四种类型。

content.text: Soft, semi soft, semi hard and hard.
content.trans: 英语：软，半软，半硬和硬。

content.text: The designation refers to the amount of moisture in the cheese which directly affects its texture.
content.trans: 该标识指的是一块奶酪中水分的量，直接决定了其质地。

content.text: Making cheese is an ancient practice dating back thousands of years and the home cheese maker can usually find recipes for cheese that fall into any of the four categories.
content.trans: 制作奶酪是几千年前就存在的古老习惯，奶酪制造者通常能找到各种类型的奶酪配方。

content.text: Soft cheese includes cottage cheese, cream cheese, ricotta,
content.trans: 软奶酪包括 cottage cheese、奶油奶酪和芝士奶酪。

content.text: brie, blue, rookfort, mozzarella,
content.trans: 好的，以下是将 "brie, blue, rookfort, mozzarella" 翻译成中文的翻译：

content.text: meister and similar cheeses.
content.trans: 我师傅和类似的奶酪。

content.text: These cheeses generally pair well with fruit or meats and can be used as breakfast cheeses in an omelette or as pasta fillings.
content.trans: 这些奶酪通常与水果或肉类搭配，可以作为煎蛋的配菜或者用作意大利面的馅料。

content.text: They are usually mildly flavored and very high in moisture.
content.trans: 他们通常口味偏淡，水分含量很高。

content.text: American, Colby, Kojak and similar cheeses are in the semi soft category.
content.trans: 美国、科尔比和科洛卡等类似奶酪在半软类别里。

content.text: These are slightly stronger in flavor and cover a wide range of uses.
content.trans: 这些是稍微更强的口味，覆盖了各种用途。

content.text: Kojak cheese, a blend of Colby and Monterey jack, is one of the most popular.
content.trans: 姜黄奶酪，一种结合了科尔比和摩森杰的混合物，是很多人喜欢的。

content.text: This allows the sharper flavor of the Colby to be combined with the milder jack cheese and also melts better than plain Colby.
content.trans: 这个功能允许Colby的香辣味与Jack咸菜的微辣结合，而且味道比普通Colby更佳。

content.text: Grilled cheese sandwiches often use American cheese and Mexican cheeses such as as a sidero and queso fresco are becoming more popular.
content.trans: 英文：烤面包通常使用美国奶酪和墨西哥奶酪，如沙拉酱和香肠，正在变得越来越受欢迎。

content.text: Hard cheeses include Parmesan, Romano, Asiago, Swiss, Gruyère and others.
content.trans: 意大利面包括帕尔马干酪、罗曼诺伊、安萨吉奥、瑞士干酪、雷司令和其他种类。

content.text: Parmesan and Romano are most familiar as the grated powder used to top spaghetti, but they are also used as a companions for fruit, wine, nuts and other appetizer items.
content.trans: 帕尔马和罗莫诺最熟悉的是用于意大利面的切碎粉，但它们也常作为水果、红酒、坚果和其他开胃菜的伴侣使用。

content.text: Swiss is a popular sandwich cheese and melts well unlike some other hard cheeses.
content.trans: 瑞士是一种受欢迎的香肠，而且它融化得非常好，不像其他一些硬奶酪那样。
